rationale: Empty states are critical UX moments that guide users on what to do next. Inconsistent empty states confuse users and miss opportunities to drive engagement. A well-designed empty state can convert a dead-end into an action.
problemSolved: Each screen implements empty states differently: PluginsScreen has styled emptyStateContainer with icon, title, description. SearchScreen has emptyContainer with different styling. HomeScreen has emptyCatalog. Some use MaterialIcons, some use Feather icons. Some have action buttons, others don't. No consistent spacing, typography, or icon sizing.
